_about: The character each playtest persona creates and plays (TalesForge.Playtest.PersonaCharacters). Picks follow docs/personas.md and docs/playtest-persona-characters.md in tales-forge-docs; provisional until the founder survey answers (Q10-Q14) arrive. base_stats are before the race modifier (75-point buy, 3-18). race_bonus only for races with a choice (Human: two stats, Elf: INT or WIS). occupation is the past occupation (free skill levels). skills are the final skill levels (skill budget 25, Human +5, Half-Elf +3; levels 1-3 cost 1, 4-5 cost 2, 6-7 cost 3 for at most two signature skills); skills not listed stay at their free level, and without skills the suggested spread is used.

hawk.name: Brannoc Hale
hawk.concept: A sellsword who survives by reading the ground before a fight and never walks in without a plan.

paul.name: Corvin Ashdown
paul.concept: A wandering lay preacher with a silver tongue and a taste for a good scene, who would rather talk a fight down than draw steel.

lotta.name: Hilde Stonebrook
lotta.concept: A gruff, plain-spoken dwarf hedge-druid, an outsider in a human mining valley, quietly hoping the valley will come to see who she really is.

lars.name: Taren Swiftbrook
lars.concept: A ranger and tracker who wants a real quest, a fight worth winning and a name the Guild will remember.

ronny.name: Maxx Goldhand
ronny.concept: The strongest build the rules allow: maxed strength and toughness, everything else dumped, here for the loot.
